Photo 0: the whole machine is wrapped in clear plastic film with printed sheets (a Pepsi advert, a flyer and colourful posters) taped over its top and front, hiding most of the body.
Photo 0: a blue 'hp' logo appears top left, but it sits on one of the paper sheets wrapped over the machine, not clearly on the printer's own casing.
Photo 0: no model name, model number, control panel or display can be read; the scanner lid and document feeder are not clearly visible.

identity.kind: office laser printer, possibly a colour multifunction (print, copy, scan)
read_from: photo 0 shows a laser printer body; the only 'hp' logo is on a paper sheet wrapped over it, and no model is readable

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a scanner, document feeder or colour output; the wrapping hides the top.
Marketing copy; speed cannot be seen in a photo and the model is unreadable.
No configuration or usage page printout or counter screen is shown.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: No photo of the drum or toner cartridges, nor a supplies status page.
No clip of the machine printing or copying.

risks.risk: Model unknown; HP colour multifunction models differ widely in value, and the brand itself is only on wrapping paper.
risks.proof: Photo of the model label on the front panel and the rating plate on the back, wrapping removed.
risks.if_unproven: not priceable; identity must be read first

risks.risk: Machine may not power on, print, copy or scan, or may jam.
risks.proof: Clip of the machine printing a colour test page and copying a document through the feeder, with a handwritten note in shot.

risks.risk: Page count may be far higher than claimed, meaning worn fuser and transfer parts.
risks.proof: Printed configuration or usage page showing total page count and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: as high page count with worn parts

risks.risk: Drum and toner may be empty, refilled or missing.
risks.proof: Printed supplies status page showing cartridge and drum levels, and a photo of the cartridges in place.
risks.if_unproven: as without usable toner or drum

risks.risk: Casing damage, cracks or missing trays hidden under the wrapping and posters.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides with the wrapping removed, trays open.
risks.if_unproven: as with cosmetic damage and missing trays

proof_requests: Photo of the model label and the back rating plate with the wrapping removed
Printed configuration or usage page showing page count and serial number
Clip of the machine printing a colour page and copying a document
Printed supplies status page and a photo of the toner and drum in place
Photos of all sides, trays and the scanner lid unwrapped
response.reason: The photo shows an office laser printer, but it is wrapped and covered in posters, the only HP logo is on a paper sheet, and no model can be read, while the model is what sets the price. The model label and a configuration page are needed before even a worst case price can be retrieved.
